scripts.build: npm run build:cp && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:cp: npm run typecheck:cp && vite build --config vite.cp.config.ts
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @verbb/comments-core && npm run build -w @verbb/comments-browser && npm run build -w @verbb/comments-web-components && npm run build -w @verbb/comments-react && npm run build -w @verbb/comments-vue
scripts.test:packages: npm run typecheck -w @verbb/comments-core && npm run test -w @verbb/comments-core && npm run typecheck -w @verbb/comments-browser && npm run test -w @verbb/comments-browser && npm run typecheck -w @verbb/comments-web-components && npm run test -w @verbb/comments-web-components && npm run typecheck -w @verbb/comments-react && npm run test -w @verbb/comments-react && npm run typecheck -w @verbb/comments-vue && npm run test -w @verbb/comments-vue
scripts.check:packages: npm run test:packages && npm run build:assets && npm run check:package-size && npm run check:package-pack
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/docs-check-reference.mjs && node scripts/docs-check-links.mjs && node scripts/docs-check-prose.mjs
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w comments-frontend
